title: SUFANIQ Cheesecloth, Grade 90 (9 Sq Ft), 100% Pure Cotton Cheese Cloths, Unbleached Ultra Fine Fabric, Reusable Cheesecloth for Straining, Cooking & Crafting, Premium Butter Muslin Cloth – 1 Sq Yard
description:
About this item
Food Grade Reusable Cheese Cloth: A true Nature's gift that brings out the real chef in you, Sufaniq cheesecloth for straining is made of 100% pure cotton cloth that is unbleached, dye-free and odorless so do not impart any color or odor to food.
Premium Cheese Cloth Fabric: Unlike others, Sufaniq reusable cheese cloths for straining are densely weaved with fine mesh. Our cheesecloth works efficiently to strain milk, yogurt, broth, fruit & vegetable juice without any need to fold or layer it.
Master Cloth Strainer: Are you troubled by the unwanted small particles that just glide in while straining? No more trespassing! Nothing passes the sight of our stretchable cheese cloth having a tight weave count of 44 x 36.
Widely Applicable Straining Cloth: You can use this butter muslin unbleached cheesecloth for straining oil and yogurt, perfect for cheese making, tofu, other poultry, canning the lids & baking. You can use our cheesecloth for cooking , roasting and basting turkey, meat and steaming vegetables.
Durable & Reusable Cheese Clothes: Our Sufaniq Grade-90 cheesecloth strainer is highly durable that can resists wear and tear with a higher thread count. This one-time trial will save you from a lot of hassle and serve you for long time.
24/7 Customer Support: Sufaniq Team works round the clock to provide their customers with best buying experience by addressing & resolving all the issues. So, Don't hesitate and contact us anytime for your queries.
